title: I LOVE THE SKIN I'M IN
note: Not released. Song: I Love the Skin I'm In (3:31, Ghanaian highlife x warehouse techno), Suno take 22876c64. Over 3:00: the vertical cut needs --cut3m-start. Covers: make in ChatGPT from the FREQ 001 cover, lines I LOVE THE|SKIN I'M IN. Calendar: freq/CALENDAR.md.
alt_text: A gold frequency ring glows around the NDCH arch-and-Y emblem on black stone veined with gold, under the title I LOVE THE SKIN I'M IN, NDCH FREQ 010. The picture pushes in slowly and the gold breathes brighter while one line repeats: I love the skin I'm in.

location.name: Black Star Square
location.why: Accra's independence square, under the Black Star Gate: a nation saying who it is, out loud. The highlife in the song comes from the same city. First day of Black History Month.
